turns.utterance: Hold a calibrated infrared thermometer or contact thermocouple probe against the drive amplifier heatsink surface after the axis has been running under normal load for twenty minutes. ground_truth.node_text: Hold a calibrated infrared thermometer or a contact thermocouple probe against the drive amplifier heatsink surface after the axis has been running under normal load for 20 minutes. Record the heatsink temperature and compare against the maximum permitted heatsink temperature stated in the drive amplifier datasheet. An overtemperature condition with normal ambient temperature indicates a failed cooling fan or blocked heatsink fins.

ground_truth.node_text: Inspect the encoder read head status indicator light on the motor body or drive amplifier; green indicates a valid signal and red or flashing indicates a fault. Check the encoder cable continuity at both the motor connector and the drive connector using a continuity tester on each signal wire. Inspect the cable route for crush damage, sharp bends, or contact with hot or moving surfaces.
